architectural_notes: Role-based access/login: when role 'ADMINISTRADOR' (and/or leader) is selected, app should validate password and open the correct role view (leader access expected for password 'Liderdoprojetox1').
known_issues: Login/auth: password validation reports 'incorrect' even when the correct password is entered (expected: entering 'Liderdoprojetox1' should open the app for the leader).

existing_features.title: Update the frontend admin password submission(s) to treat "Liderdoprojetox1" as the correct password and ensure successful verification grants access (i.e., passing the admin gate / opening the leader experience) when the backend confirms the password is valid.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update the backend admin password verification so that entering the password string "Liderdoprojetox1" is accepted as correct and returns true from verifyAdminPassword.
Fix the backend stored/default admin password value so it matches the expected leader password "Liderdoprojetox1" (remove the trailing semicolon currently present in backend/main.mo).

Update any backend allowlisting/admin-grant functions that compare password text (e.g., addAllowlistedAdminPrincipal/addAllowlistedAdmin/removeAllowlistedAdminPrincipal/revokeAllowlistedAdmin) so that the leader password "Liderdoprojetox1" successfully allowlists the caller principal when used from the profile setup admin flow.

Add/adjust a conditional canister state migration so that existing deployed state with the old admin password value "Liderdoprojetox1;" is updated to the new expected value "Liderdoprojetox1" without affecting any other persisted state (including allowlisted admin principals).
